chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali from his father from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-'Is ibn al-Qasim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about drinking the milk of donkeys, so he said, 'Drink it.'
ai.seo_question: Is donkey milk permissible to drink in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the permissibility of donkey milk, distinguishing it from the prohibition often cited regarding donkey meat. The concise response from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the specific legal nuance in Shia jurisprudence where the ruling for the flesh does not automatically extend to the milk, reflecting the principle of *istishab* (presumption of permissibility) for consumables unless proven otherwise.
